facts.text: SNU encourages students to take at least one study abroad course, utilizing campuses and partners in multiple continents including SNU's Quetzal Education Research Center in Costa Rica.

sources.title: Global Studies - Southern Nazarene University
sources.quote: SNU encourages students to take at least one study abroad course. These courses take advantage of campuses and partners in multiple continents, including SNU's Quetzal Education Research Center in Costa Rica.
